headline: Jalen Hurts expected to miss season after blood clots discovered in QB's lungs
summary: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season after doctors discovered multiple blood clots in his lungs, according to NFL Network and ESPN.

headline: Colts fire GM Chris Ballard after home loss to Titans, cite 'necessary' change
summary: The Colts fired GM Chris Ballard one day after losing to the previously winless Titans. Owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon said "a change in leadership is necessary."

headline: Sources: Falcons to sign QB Andy Dalton, release QB Cooper Rush
summary: The Falcons are signing quarterback Andy Dalton, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday, and are are releasing quarterback Cooper Rush, NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported.

headline: Davante Adams suffered non-contact leg injury late in Sunday's loss to Cardinals
summary: If Adams misses time, Rams become thin (again) at receiver position.

headline: Chiefs' Patrick Mahomes earns 100th win in 131st start, tying Tom Brady
summary: Quarterback Patrick Mahomes earned his 100th win with the Chiefs in his 131st regular-season start Sunday, tying Tom Brady for the fewest games needed to reach 100 career wins.
